name: Reduce recurrent-state materialization
source_model_term: Fused recurrent decode kernel and adjacent state operations
hypothesis: Keep recurrent state in the consumer layout and fuse adjacent transforms to remove round trips and small launches.
derivation: The recurrent kernel alone consumes 0.306 ms/decode step in the expanded CUDA graph; the ceiling leaves mandatory recurrence work intact and treats only state traffic and neighboring launch overhead as removable.

evidence.claim: Per-family GPU-active time for recurrent decode and neighboring kernels.
